name: combobox
description: Picks one option from a long list by typing to filter it, such as a country, a timezone or a teammate; for about 15 options or fewer use a select. The button in the box opens the full list, and text that matches nothing says so. Compose the parts inside Combobox: ComboboxLabel, ComboboxInput, ComboboxDescription, ComboboxError (renders only while the value is invalid) and ComboboxPopover holding ComboboxItems, all exported from the combobox file. Each ComboboxItem's id is the value onChange reports and the form submits.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the form submits the chosen item's id.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled chosen item id; pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially chosen item id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen item's id, or null when the input is cleared.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Keeps typed text that matches no item instead of resetting it when the field is left.

props.name: allowsEmptyCollection
props.description: Keeps the list open with a "No matches" line when the text matches nothing; false closes it instead.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a choice before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims the field.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: { value: Key | null; inputValue: string }) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid choice, shown by ComboboxError.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates as soon as the choice changes.

example:
<Combobox name="country">
  <ComboboxLabel>Country</ComboboxLabel>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Type to search" />
  <ComboboxPopover>
    <ComboboxItem id="uz">Uzbekistan</ComboboxItem>
    <ComboboxItem id="kz">Kazakhstan</ComboboxItem>
  </ComboboxPopover>
</Combobox>
